label: At least one individual exists at the…, from The selected sum actually exists at w AND… and 4 more
meaning: Assume the scoped negation of existing NecessaryBeing. Every actual x then has no necessary parts: any necessary p ≤ x would be actual by the actual-part policy and would witness the denied NE. The explicitly actual sum therefore has no necessary parts and gets a cause c by the causal input. Causal actuality makes c actual, so the SAME reductio also makes c have no necessary parts. Thus c belongs to the exact fusion family and Fusion.upper places c below the sum. The common part c witnesses forbidden cause/effect overlap. Discharge the scoped denial classically to obtain SOME actual necessary individual. This does not establish that c is necessary. No L1/L2/A1, modal frame, concrete profile, grounding or source-truth premise is smuggled in.
